content.short: KALYX is a one-stop shop to your dCFDs. Our 3-steps contract maker is a pinnacle of efficiency and usability.
content.description:
Kalyx is a market maker of Decentralized Contracts for Future Difference (dCFD). Our solution is fast, intuitive and reliable. Unlike oder CEX builds, our solution has been purposely made to help Cardano users easily to create new contract or to step to one that is already available. Customer convenience was our driving factor in implementing algorithm with minimum blockchain fees. The hyper-collateralized setup of our contracts allows to set lower TVLs for investment or hedging against your main positions on exchanges. No registration needed, just connect your Cardano Wallet and decide for the next step.

Smart contract persists and evaluates the TVL (maker, taker) and settlement of each contract directly on Cardano blockchain. Client end-point is available on https://kalyx.io. We also plan to include 3rd parties, APIs and loyalty program for our “regulars”.

We are looking forward to have you with us, enjoy the one of the kind product on the web3 landscape and give us a shout in case of troubles or with ideas to improve or serve better.
